clients.name: macOS
clients.verified: Native startup/UI, all themes, Mac/Windows encrypted transfers and mounted/copied notarized app checks.
clients.pending: Human installation review and broader physical-network coverage.

clients.name: Windows
clients.verified: Windows 11 native engine, high-DPI UI, install/update/uninstall and setup-wizard checks.

clients.name: AmigaOS
clients.verified: Owner-confirmed native installation, app/Preferences startup and bridged discovery; host LHa/OLHa extraction.
clients.pending: Exact native OLHa/LHa archive check pending; broader hardware and TCP/IP stacks.

clients.name: Linux
clients.target: GTK desktop and CLI; arm64/x86-64; Ubuntu 24.04 baseline
clients.verified: arm64 native process/GTK tests; x86-64 process tests through emulation; TLS, folders and result notifications.
clients.pending: Physical x86-64, real Wayland sessions and other distributions.

clients.name: DOS / mTCP
clients.verified: DOS runtime transfers in both directions, discovery, queues, folders and receive decisions.
clients.pending: Physical network cards and older DOS versions.

clients.name: Atari TOS / MiNTNet
clients.verified: Target builds; STinG app startup and Transfer tools navigation.

clients.name: RISC OS
clients.verified: Compile/link and package checks for both CPU variants.
clients.pending: Native startup, transfers and physical hardware.

clients.name: iPhone / iPad
clients.verified: Local runtime TLS transfers, file/folder review, file management, themes and accessibility layout checks.
clients.pending: Physical devices, authenticated cloud providers and VoiceOver; local Files runtime issue remains documented.

clients.name: Android
clients.verified: Android 17 local runtime/JNI TLS transfers, folder staging, minimized-transfer cancellation and accessibility layout checks.
clients.pending: Physical devices, Wi-Fi discovery, older Android versions, authenticated providers and TalkBack.

clients.name: Windows 3.x
clients.verified: 8086 large-model build; NE format and Win16 import checks.
clients.pending: Native startup, Winsock stacks, transfers, cancellation and keyboard review.

clients.name: Classic Mac OS 8/9
clients.verified: Shared pinned Retro68 PowerPC compiler build.
clients.pending: Networking SDK, safe HFS/Open Transport adapters and all native app/transfer checks; no client binary.

scope: These are observed 0.2 checks, with limitations retained explicitly. The new file-date extension has host socket coverage; native date preservation still needs review on each target. Release candidates require their own artifact acceptance checks.
